card.name: Modifier or verb before a key medical term
card.fires_on: A modifier, auxiliary or linking word just before an expected noun or verb in medical or technical prose, such as 'moderate' before 'degrees' or 'may' before 'present'. It sits in the middle of a clause, where the next word is a predictable content term.

modes.label: Adjective or adverb
modes.description: An adjective or adverb that qualifies the next medical noun or verb.

modes.label: Auxiliary or linking word
modes.description: A small verb or conjunction such as may, must, have or and, placed before the main verb or last list item.
modes.example: FDE<< may>> present as a more severe variant known as
